params.message:
The team's assistant gets the guide, what waits, sources and questions through /mcp

Six more tools, listed to the proven team only and answered by the Observatory: guide,
question_note, question_list, desk_open, source_find and source_trial. Every tool is on
the first page of the list. The instructions say to offer a written question instead of
a mail. MCP contract 4.2.0, added only.

The page of a source that nothing on the site cites says it is kept, not cited.

Portal: Het team kan vanuit een gekoppelde assistent meer zelf; een bewaarde bron heet op haar pagina niet langer geciteerd.
